code_identity_contract.submission_value: EXPECTED_COMMIT is the full 40-character candidate SHA supplied to qsub
code_identity_contract.required_equality: EXPECTED_COMMIT == clean worktree HEAD == manifest identities.code.commit

atomic_authority_contract.publication_unit: one immutable compound payload containing new parameters outer optimizer state selected contribution facts fixed consumption frontiers policy identity update identity and integrity metadata
atomic_authority_contract.visibility_unit: one small fixed per-fragment current record atomically replaced after payload verification
atomic_authority_contract.success_boundary: replacement of the current visibility record; selected sequence and base frontiers become authoritative only through the newly visible compound payload
atomic_authority_contract.reader_outcomes: every fresh reader sees either the complete old authority or complete new authority and never a mixed parameter optimizer frontier or policy tuple
atomic_authority_contract.forbidden: independent latest parameters outer state or consumed-frontier records and any shared global head

version_contract.successor: requested and published next version equals current version plus exactly one and outer update count also increments by one
version_contract.retry: an exact retry after a completed current-record replacement returns the same content and update identities without another version increment
version_contract.conflict: version skip rollback or same next version with different semantic content fails before replacing current

consumption_contract.frontier_shape: one fixed ordered sequence and base-version pair per frozen learner and fragment
consumption_contract.advance: only selected distinct learners advance to exactly their selected proposal sequence and base version
consumption_contract.failure: all pre-replace interruptions retain byte-identical old frontiers so every previously selected proposal remains eligible under the old authority
consumption_contract.late_arrival: the immutable selected set and float32 weights are commit facts; a proposal arriving after freeze is absent from the commit and may participate only through a later eligible selection

concurrency_observation: eight reader threads repeatedly load the one current slot during successful replacements and classify complete authority identities over their common writer interval
formal_package: S1-00 builder finalizer and validator with clean code config source skill scheduler role path and checksum identities plus fail-if-exists root
failure_ladder: preserve the first formal L2 package and reproduce proposal writer reader plus atomic committer on one compute node with the same candidate and profile before any resubmission
